claims.trunk_turn_axis: Best-fit functional direction and mismatch cone associated with complete pelvis-relative left/right torso-turn bouts.
claims.trunk_flex_axis: Best-fit functional direction and mismatch cone associated with complete pelvis-relative forward-flexion and recovery bouts.
claims.functional_frame: The turn and flex directions define a non-clinical trunk functional subspace/frame.
claims.off_axis_motion: Natural off-axis motion, pelvic compensation, and human variability are nuisance/model mismatch, not operator failure.
claims.orthogonality: An exact coordinate convention in the minimal functional-frame parameterization; it is not information attributed to the human body.
claims.neutral_and_replay_identity: The same declared functional frame is used for neutral-zero estimation and label-blind replay application.
